subject: Hybrid Ward Representation for City Council
overview: The committee provisionally approved transitioning to a hybrid ward representation system for the City Council. It also established subcommittees to draft a charter preamble and review the balance of power between the executive and legislative branches.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the October meeting minutes with an amendment to correct the attendance record.

items.title: Hybrid Ward Representation
items.summary: Approved a provisional move to a hybrid ward representation system for the City Council following a debate on diversity, campaign costs, and the risk of ward-based parochialism.

items.title: Charter Preamble
items.summary: Voted to include a preamble in the charter and established a subcommittee to research and draft language reflecting the committee's values.

items.title: Balance of Power Discussion
items.summary: Discussed executive and legislative authorities, specifically noting that state statutes strictly define the municipal budget process and limit local charter modifications.

items.title: Executive and Legislative Subcommittee
items.summary: Established a subcommittee to review Articles 2 and 3 of the charter, focusing on the grants of power and interactions between the executive and legislative branches.

items.title: Listening Sessions and Survey Updates
items.summary: Scheduled several community listening sessions and discussed strategies to increase public participation in the ongoing charter survey.
